تمتلكن (form VIII)
# تَمْتَلِكْنَ (tamtalikna) /tam.ta.lik.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# تُمْتَلَكْنَ (tumtalakna) /tum.ta.lak.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
